title: Increase and decrease a number
objective: Add to or take away from a changing number with increase and decrease, using a number or another variable.

body.text: increase adds an amount to a changing number, and decrease takes an amount away. They are shorter than set when you only want to move a number up or down. increase score by 10 means the same as set score to score plus 10.

body.title: Adding and taking away
body.code:
make changing score equal to 0
increase score by 10
say score
make changing lives equal to 3
decrease lives by 1
say lives

body.text: The amount can be a number, or the name of a variable that holds one. Both forms work for increase and decrease. This example uses a variable for the amount.

body.title: The amount can be a variable
body.code:
make changing total equal to 100
make bonus equal to 20
increase total by bonus
say total
make changing score equal to 100
make penalty equal to 10
decrease score by penalty
say score

body.text: increase and decrease also work on a field of a structure, such as increase score of player by 5. The field must belong to a changing structure.

body.prompt: The player starts with 3 lives and should end with 2, but the program never changes the count. Make it print 2.
body.starter:
make changing lives equal to 3
say lives
body.solution:
make changing lives equal to 3
decrease lives by 1
say lives
